en.title: Your ETA is linked to one passport

items.text: The ETA is linked to this booklet
The link does not carry over
Apply for a new ETA before you fly

en.focal: Everyone travelling needs their own, children included
en.alt: Comparison diagram: the passport you applied with keeps the ETA linked to that booklet so you travel as normal, while a new or renewed passport does not carry the link over and needs a new ETA before you fly, and everyone travelling needs their own, children included
en.caption: The approval is tied to the booklet, not to you - and each traveller carries their own.
